info.name: Export the results of a motion's execution

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass the nextCursor from the previous response.

params.name: since
params.description: Only return runs created/updated after this ISO8601 timestamp.

params.name: until
params.description: Only return runs created/updated before this ISO8601 timestamp.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status. Defaults to completed.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to include (runId always included).

items.docs: Retrieve contacts and accounts processed by a motion, along with their evaluation outcomes and action summaries. Cursor-paginated; ideal for polling for motion results at a regular interval.
